title: Polynomial repetition budget
statement: For natural numbers $L,N,k,K,a,d$ with $N\le L$, the quantity $2L+9+k(3L+7)+N\bigl(a(K(L+1)^2+1)^d+2\bigr)+K(L+1)^2$ is at most $(13+7k+a(K+1)^d+K)(L+1)^{2d+3}$.
replaced: For all naturals with $N \le L$, the complete repetition ledger, preparation $2L + 9 + k(3L+7)$, plus $N$ calls each costing the clean-call polynomial evaluated at the quadratic state bound $K(L+1)^2$, plus the final replay $K(L+1)^2$, is at most $(13 + 7k + a(K+1)^d + K)(L+1)^{2d+3}$.
